# LuxeRide

> LuxeRide is a white-label software platform for luxury ground transportation
> operators (limousine, black car, chauffeur, and airport transfer companies).
> It is operated by JPRS Digital Connect. LuxeRide is software only — it is
> not a transportation carrier, does not own vehicles, and does not employ
> drivers. Each operator runs its own independent transportation business on
> top of LuxeRide's software.

## What LuxeRide does

- Online booking engine with instant, rule-based fare pricing (by zone, distance, or fixed route)
- Real-time dispatch board and driver assignment (manual or automatic)
- Card payments via Whop, plus manual payment tracking (cash, Zelle, bank transfer)
- Corporate accounts with credit lines, per-user limits, and automatic invoicing
- Cancellation and no-show policy engine, deposits and gratuities
- Live GPS trip tracking shared with passengers, in-app chat, and post-trip ratings
- Compliance Center: tracks license, permit, and insurance expiration dates for the operator's own records (an organizational tool — LuxeRide does not certify or guarantee regulatory compliance)
- Each operator gets its own branded booking page, available in English, Spanish, and Portuguese
- Reports, CSV exports, and audit trail

## Pricing (as of 2026-07-08)

- Starter — $99/month: up to 6 vehicles and 6 chauffeurs, up to 150 bookings/month, 2 team members, 3% platform fee per completed trip
- Professional — $299/month: up to 15 vehicles and 15 chauffeurs, unlimited bookings, 8 team members, corporate accounts, real-time dispatch, 1.5% platform fee
- Elite — $548.99/month: unlimited vehicles, chauffeurs and team members, affiliate network (send/receive trips with other LuxeRide operators), 0.5% platform fee
- Enterprise — custom pricing: multiple companies/DBAs, dedicated account manager, custom integrations

No setup fees on any plan.

## Key differentiators vs. competitors (Limo Anywhere, Moovs)

- Trilingual (English/Spanish/Portuguese) out of the box — competitors are English-only
- No setup fee on any plan
- Platform fee decreases as operators grow, rather than a flat per-trip charge regardless of fare
